description: Throwaway probe for plain-english issue 151. Inactive until a prompt contains pe-probe:on or the task folder holds PE-COWORK-PROBE.md.

hooks.command: if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/observe.mjs" SessionStart; else echo '{"systemMessage":"pe-probe: SessionStart ran, but no node on PATH"}'; fi
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/observe.mjs" UserPromptSubmit; else echo '{"systemMessage":"pe-probe: UserPromptSubmit ran, but no node on PATH"}'; fi
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/observe.mjs" PreToolUse; else echo '{"systemMessage":"pe-probe: PreToolUse ran, but no node on PATH"}'; fi
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/observe.mjs" PostToolUse; fi
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/observe.mjs" Stop; else echo '{"systemMessage":"pe-probe: Stop ran, but no node on PATH"}'; fi
